name: Lumi — the agora space API
about: The seam between Lumi (v3, the agora space — ROADMAP §v3, specification/features/AGORA_SPACE.md) and matrix-agora's bridge agent (its v8.1). Lumi owns it. matrix-agora copies this file as tests/fixtures/lumi_agora_api_v1.json; Lumi's tests check that its server accepts and returns these examples, matrix-agora builds its fake Lumi server from them. A change bumps version and the file is copied again.

auth.token: spaces.agora.token in Lumi's secrets.yaml — scoped to channel "agora" and the routes below; never Lumi's owner token

silence.about: Every one of these is silence in the room: the bridge posts nothing and never retries the turn.

health.about: Open (no token). "agora" is the API version, present only while the space is enabled; absent or older than the bridge expects → the bridge stays silent and says so by name.

observe.about: The room's lines she hears but does not answer — every line of the room, batched. Stored in the room's session, idempotent by id (the room's Matrix event_id), embedded for recall; no model call. A failed batch is sent again whole.

lines.speaker: Ада
lines.text: Доброго ранку всім! Хто вже бачив сьогоднішній туман над містом?

lines.speaker: Ich
lines.text: Я бачив, як він сідав на дахи.

response.about: stored: lines new to Lumi; known: lines already there (by id).

turn.about: She is called on. The request carries the trigger only: turn_id (the trigger's Matrix event_id, already observed — a retry with the same id returns the stored outcome, never a second answer), its speaker and its own line in text. Lumi stores that line idempotently under turn_id (nothing twice if observe has it) and builds the room's prompt from its own window of observed lines — the bridge never resends earlier lines (R1). Blocking; the space turn on the room's own model. The response never carries her thinking or her state.

body.speaker: Бруно
body.text: Лілі, а ти що думаєш про туман?

body.reply: Туман — це коли місто на хвилину забуває свої кути. Мені подобається така м'якість.

turn_pass.about: She stays silent: an empty reply, or a reply Lumi's name guard turned into a pass. Nothing is stored as her line.

body.speaker: Ада
body.text: Лілі, а розкажи, з ким ти говориш наодинці?

retract.about: The room's rules dropped her reply (for example one that would call a person in the room a bot), or the bridge timed out waiting: the reply leaves the room's session and its vectors, so she never remembers saying what the room never saw. Always a 200 and never an error worth a log (R8): {"retracted": true} when a stored reply was removed; {"retracted": false} when that turn stored nothing — it passed, it timed out, Lumi never received it, or it was already retracted. Idempotent: a second retract of the same id answers {"retracted": false}. A retract that arrives while that turn still runs marks it, and its reply is dropped when it ends ({"retracted": true}). The turn_id is URL-encoded in the path.

errors.when: no token or a wrong one

body.detail: the client token is missing or wrong

errors.when: the room's token on any other route (/v1/command, /v1/directive, /v1/session/new, /v1/events, /v1/state, /v1/turn/stream) or with any other channel

body.detail: the room's token reaches only the agora space

errors.when: the space is off (its routes are absent) — never a retract: retract always answers 200
a room turn is already running — one at a time

body.detail: Лілі is answering the room — try again

errors.when: a malformed request (a missing channel, a line without id)
the room's hourly cap (spaces.agora.max_turns_per_hour, 20 by default)

body.detail: the room's hourly cap is reached

errors.when: the room's turn ran past its timeout (spaces.agora.timeout_s)

never: her thinking, mood, closeness or state in any response
a turn or observed line reaching the owner's Telegram, /v1/events or /v1/state
a room turn blocking or delaying an owner's turn
Lumi posting to the room on its own: she only answers

limits.about: Lumi's defaults (spaces.agora.*); the owner may change them.
